purpose.summary: This program performs an analytical payroll journal update ('mise à jour journal de paie analytique'). It reads payroll journal, working-time (jours), pay-code (codpaie), and parameter (parex) files, then distributes salary amounts across analytical cost centres/postings and writes results to an intermediate indexed file (INTER). It handles proration of salary components by analytical keys and cotisation (social contribution) ventilation.

notable_features: COMP-3 (packed decimal) fields used extensively for monetary and hour amounts

verdict.notes: The file contains customer-specific sequence-area labels (SOCOM, SISTO, LUXLAI) in columns 1-6, which are site-specific conditional patches rather than standard COBOL features. The program is clearly production payroll software, likely Belgian or French-speaking given the French comments and European decimal convention. Source was truncated at 16000 chars; the full file is 18376 bytes. The ASSIGN TO RANDOM syntax and C$RERR call strongly suggest ACUCOBOL-GT, though Micro Focus with ACUCOBOL compatibility is also possible.
